sql: CREATE TABLE "account_scans" ("accountId" integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "collection" text, "wishlist" text, "followers" text, "following" text, CONSTRAINT "FK_b5e963acca6ece2ad79368aca86" FOREIGN KEY ("accountId") REFERENCES "accounts" ("id") ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION)

name: accounts

name: followers

name: items

name: items_to_accounts

name: tags
